text:
Situation: Metronidazole injection from Baxter Healthcare has been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-01-13 and was last updated 2026-10-16. The shortage has persisted for 57 months as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 139 units of B. Braun 500 mg/100 mL solution with 9.6 days on hand and 95 units of another 500 mg/100 mL bag with 8.2 days on hand. Corvale General holds three lots totaling 1,163 units with 21.7 to 30.3 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 70 units with 21 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows metronidazole injection from Baxter Healthcare as Current since initial posting on 2022-01-13, last updated 2026-10-16. Baxter Healthcare Corporation plant FEI 1416980 received OAI classifications on 2024-08-01 and 2026-04-02, with a Warning Letter issued 2026-09-29. Another Baxter plant FEI 2618677 has multiple OAI classifications from 2010 through 2016, most recent inspection VAI on 2024-07-19.

Our position: Internal transfer can stabilize Corvale East supply within days. Alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today but require procurement lead time and plant verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 64 units of 500 mg/100 mL solution from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
2. Initiate purchase from Hospira, Inc. — requires buyer approval.
3. Initiate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals Private Limited — requires buyer approval.
4. Initiate purchase from Civica, Inc. — requires buyer approval.
5. Initiate purchase from WG Critical Care, LLC — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Delaying transfer pending new purchases; relying solely on Baxter supply given ongoing regulatory findings.
